themes.evidence: Our story begins with what it truly means to be a technology innovator.
It takes a combination of engineering disciplines, along with computer science, geophysics, and metallurgy.
We believe energy makes society progress, so we find ways to help our customers fuel agriculture, industry, medicine, science, space, technology, and transportation.
We are developing methods and processes using ever-less-invasive means minimizing environmental footprints while maximizing positive influence on the communities in which we live and work.

linguistic_shift: The page emphasizes innovation, collaboration, and customer focus more prominently than before.
